test_item:
Generate CSR message.
(CSR is read over DID 2965 and exported to a file)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. ADA Active Roles permit ADA+ protected data identifiers
3. The ECU serial number has been written
4. The CSR is generated at boot
proc:
1. Send UDS request DiagnosticSessionControl for the SystemSupplierSpecific session
$ 10 60
2. Send UDS request ReadDataByIdentifier for DID 2965 (CSR Read)
$ 22 29 65
3. Export the CSR file from the DUT to the host
$ adb pull /data/misc/ecuidentity/ecu.crt
4. Check the exported CSR on the host
$ openssl req -in ecu.crt -noout -verify
er:
1. Positive response is received: 50 60
2. Positive response is received: 62 29 65 <CSR bytes>, up to 1000 bytes
3. The adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity output lists "ecu.crt" on the DUT
4. The openssl command prints "verify OK" on stdout
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: R-SEC6(a) UDS step form; CS.00102 5.2.2.75 (SYS-RA-CS00102-415 to -418); ECU Cert Test Steps PDF Step 2; CCVR ECU ID CS.165 item 12 (openssl req verbatim)
SWE ID pending; the SYSAD identifier is used instead
The consistency between the DID payload and ecu.crt is not asserted: no comparison means is available in the delivered material
